matter.title: Estate of Gwendolyn May Pryce
openTasks: List the house for sale after Easter

query: What did Nerida say at the attendance on 4 March?
answer: At the attendance on 4 March 2026, Nerida Cole confirmed that she and Alistair want the house sold after Easter, and asked whether the piano could go to Alistair before the house is listed. Jordan Price said the firm would check the will and come back to her.
